description: Defines the DnsConfigService class for managing system DNS configuration, including reading, watching for changes, and handling DNS hosts. Contains nested classes for watching DNS config changes and reading hosts files.

classes.name: DnsConfigService
classes.description: Manages reading and monitoring system DNS configuration, including DNS settings and hosts files. Provides interfaces for reading config, watching for changes, and triggering refreshes.

classes.name: DnsConfigService::Watcher
classes.description: Abstract class for watching DNS configuration or hosts file changes, triggering refreshes upon change detection.

classes.name: DnsConfigService::HostsReader
classes.description: Reads the system's hosts file, with platform-specific logic, and provides parsed DNS hosts data.

classes.name: DnsConfigService::HostsReader::WorkItem
classes.description: Represents a unit of work for reading and parsing hosts file, used within serial worker framework.

methods.name: CreateSystemService
methods.description: Creates a platform-specific instance of DnsConfigService, or returns nullptr if unsupported.

methods.name: ReadConfig
methods.description: Attempts to read current DNS configuration and executes callback upon success.

methods.name: WatchConfig
methods.description: Starts watching for DNS configuration changes, executing callback on change.

methods.name: RefreshConfig
methods.description: Triggers re-reading of DNS configuration, used for external notifications.

methods.name: TriggerOnConfigChangedForTesting
methods.description: Simulates a config change trigger for testing purposes.

methods.name: ReadConfigNow
methods.description: Immediately reads the current DNS configuration (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: StartWatching
methods.description: Starts system-specific watchers for DNS config changes.

methods.name: InvalidateConfig
methods.description: Marks current DNS config as invalid, prompting re-read.

methods.name: InvalidateHosts
methods.description: Marks current hosts data as invalid, prompting re-read.

methods.name: OnConfigRead
methods.description: Handles new DNS config data after reading.

methods.name: OnHostsRead
methods.description: Handles new hosts data after reading.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts timer for delayed config change processing.

methods.name: OnTimeout
methods.description: Handles timer expiration, indicating config may be ready.

methods.name: OnConfigChanged
methods.description: Handles notification of DNS config change.

methods.name: OnHostsChanged
methods.description: Handles notification of hosts file change.
